name: aw_ready_waits_for_w
why: AWREADY waits for WVALID, coupling the address channel to the data channel

name: write_while_response_pending
why: a held pair is written while the previous response is stalled, so that response is overwritten

name: out_of_range_write_aliases
why: an out-of-range write lands in the register its low address bits alias

name: index_from_low_address_bits
why: the register index uses byte-address bits 2:0 instead of word bits 4:2

name: byte_strobes_ignored
why: read/write registers take all four bytes whatever WSTRB says

name: w1c_clear_beats_set
why: a flag raised at the same edge as its write-1-to-clear is lost

name: read_reaccept_while_stalled
why: a new ARVALID is captured while R is stalled, changing RDATA under backpressure

name: out_of_range_read_aliases
why: an out-of-range read returns the aliased register instead of zero
